mapper.select:
SELECT info.id, info.`code`, info.`name`, info.`status`, info.expire_date, info.acquisition_platform FROM bp_equipment_info AS info JOIN bp_equipment_station_info AS station ON info.id = station.equipment_id WHERE info.is_deleted = 0 AND station.is_deleted = 0 and station.station_id in
#{item}

SELECT info.id, info.`code`, info.`name`, info.`status`, info.acquisition_platform FROM bp_equipment_info AS info JOIN bp_equipment_tag_info AS tag ON info.id = tag.equipment_id JOIN bp_equipment_tag AS bp ON tag.tag_id = bp.id WHERE info.is_deleted = 0 AND tag.is_deleted = 0 AND bp.is_deleted = 0 and info.`enable` = 1 AND bp.`code` =#{tagCode} GROUP BY info.id

SELECT info.* FROM bp_equipment_info AS info JOIN bp_equipment_tag_info as tag on info.id = tag.equipment_id where info.is_deleted = 0 and tag.is_deleted = 0 and info.`enable` = 1
and info.id in
#{infoId}
and info.`code` like concat('%',#{code},'%')
and info.`name` like concat('%',#{name},'%')
and tag.tag_id in
#{id}
GROUP BY tag.equipment_id ORDER BY field(info.`status`,4,1,2,3) ASC,info.`name` ASC

select ap.id, ap.code, ap.name, ap.data_point_name, ap.data_type, ap.status, ap.`type` from bp_equipment_acquisition ea left join bp_acquisition_point ap on ea.acquisition_point_id = ap.id where ea.equipment_id = #{equipmentId} and ap.status='ENABLE' and ea.is_deleted = 0 and ap.is_deleted = 0

SELECT info.id as id, info.`code` as code, info.`name` as name, info.`enable` as enable, info.is_deleted as deleted, info.acquisition_platform FROM bp_equipment_info AS info where info.id in
#{equipmentId}
